verdict.rationale: The product ships agent-oriented markdown instructions: SKILL.md files written for agents (for example ledger-tasks-yylo, ralph-loop-yylo and understand-project-yylo), installable into agents via the skills CLI. However, there is no evidence of an llms.txt, and the probe for a markdown docs endpoint returned 404. Missing for 10: a published llms.txt or llms-full.txt, a working agent-readable docs index/endpoint, and independent corroboration of agents consuming the docs directly.
